001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
004
005import java.util.List;
006
007/**
008 * Thread-safe. Registered categories appear below the built-in buttons of the cosmetics hub, 7 per row, up to 21.
009 * Additional categories are ignored, and the core logs a warning.
010 */
011public interface CosmeticsRegistry {
012
013    /**
014     * Register a cosmetics category.
015     * @param owner The plugin that owns the category
016     * @param category The category
017     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the id is already registered or invalid.
018     */
019    void register(Plugin owner, CosmeticCategory category);
020
021    /**
022     * Unregister a cosmetics category.
023     * @param id The category id
024     * @return true if a category with this id was registered
025     */
026    boolean unregister(String id);
027
028    /**
029     * Unregister every category of a plugin.
030     * Called automatically by the core when {@code owner} is disabled.
031     * @param owner The plugin
032     */
033    void unregisterAll(Plugin owner);
034
035    /**
036     * Unmodifiable snapshot, ordered by priority.
037     * @return The registered categories, never null
038     */
039    List<CosmeticCategory> getCategories();
040
041}
